title: Slovakian-Style French Pork Belly with Pineapple Galette
description: A French-inspired dish featuring tender pork belly slow-cooked in a Slovakian-style brine with a sweet and tangy pineapple galette on top.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, combine pork belly, Slovakian brine, white wine, and brown sugar (if using).
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven. Braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
While the pork is cooking, roll out the galette dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Arrange the pineapple rings on top of the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the pineapple to form a crust.
Bake the galette in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the pork from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Slice the pork into thick pieces and serve with the pineapple galette on top.
